Subject: Your consumer complaint matter - CC/2625/2023

Dear Ms. Bhatt,

Thank you for meeting us on 11/08/2023 about your dispute with Pai Realty. As we understand it, the builder keeps promising possession by email but never delivers.

Our advice is to keep every written promise of possession because each one extends the period of limitation. Please collect the allotment letter, the builder-buyer agreement, payment receipts and all emails promising possession and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs 83,40,000.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
